_comment: Files that already failed `node --check` when the check suite was built, and that
W1-CHECK-SUITE was not authorised to fix (its brief forbids modifying any source file).
The syntax gate names them on every run but does not count them as failures, so that
`npm run check` passes on a clean tree and people actually run it.
This list is one-way. Adding to it should require a ruling. Removing from it is free —
and the gate FAILS if a listed file starts parsing, which forces the stale entry to be
deleted rather than left to rot. The baseline can only ever shrink.
Both current entries are unreferenced dead code, verified per CHIP-PROTOCOL.md §7 by
basename grep across .js/.html/.md: each file's only hits are its own declarations.
That is why `npm run build` passes despite them — vite never pulls them into a graph.

files.cause: Backticks inside template literals are backslash-escaped (\`/api/news/articles/\${articleId}\`), which is not valid JavaScript. Looks like the file was written through a shell heredoc, or pasted from somewhere that kept the escaping.
files.reachable: no — grep by basename finds only its own definitions at lines 2, 104 and 183; its single global (window.newsWidgetFunctions) has no consumers anywhere in the repo

files.cause: Same backslash-escaped backticks inside template literals.
files.reachable: no — grep by basename finds only its own class declaration at line 5. Sibling modules in graphene-news ARE reached, via `await import()` from server/routes/news.js (7 call sites, all of ContentAcquisitionService.js), but this one is not.
